answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. KL 0.142 falls in the fine-tuned range (0.081-0.205) and is well above quantized (0.039-0.071) and below system-prompted (0.197-0.339). TV 0.084 fits fine-tuned (0.076-0.099) and is below system-prompted (0.108-0.144) and above quantized (0.048-0.055). Token-DiFR gap 0.145 fits fine-tuned (0.10-0.31), not quantized (0.03-0.04). Raw-score shift/TV of 3.1 sits at the low edge of fine-tuned (3.1-10.8) and is also within system-prompted (3.3-3.9) but outside quantized (2.2-2.3). Top-1 agreement 0.904 and sequence agreement 0.484 overlap both fine-tuned and system-prompted, so those do not separate them. System-prompted is the closest alternative, but KL, TV and DiFR all favor fine-tuned. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
